question: Processes (arrival, burst ms): P1 (1, 4), P2 (4, 2), P3 (5, 5), P4 (10, 1). Draw the Gantt chart using a multilevel feedback queue with 2 queues and preemptive priority between queues. Q1: Round Robin, q = 2 ms, highest priority; a process that does not finish its time slice moves to Q2. Q2: FCFS, lowest priority; a process preempted from Q2 goes to the end of Q2. Initially all arriving processes are assigned to Q1.
